title: Local stalk equality for maps from a finite free retract to an arbitrary target
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W\subseteq U\subseteq X$ open, and $x\in W$. Let $M$ be a module sheaf on the slice over $U$, supplied with a finite-free splitting $\iota:M\to\mathcal O_U^m$, $\pi:\mathcal O_U^m\to M$, $\iota\pi=1_M$ as in [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let $N$ be any module sheaf on the slice over $W$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. If $a,b:M|_W\to N$ have equal maps under the open module stalk functor at $x$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor], there is an open $x\in V\subseteq W$ such that $a|_V=b|_V$. No bounded complex or affine open is required, and no finiteness of $N$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, finite-type injectivity proof (second paragraph); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CP, read 2026-10-13. Specialized finite-generator argument for step 1 of lem-sc-perfect-open-stalk-degreewise-shrink.

proof.text: Restrict the inclusion and projection to W; their composite remains the identity by functoriality. Precompose a-b with the projection from the restricted finite free sheaf. Its stalk map is zero because the maps of a and b on the open module stalk coincide. Convert the slice site to W.toScheme. Restriction of scalars is faithful, so the zero stalk map means zero action on every section germ.

Transport the restricted source splitting to W.toScheme with Modules.overEquiv, overMapUnitIso and mapFreeIso. Faithfulness of restriction of scalars gives equality of the stalk maps. Precompose with the transported free projection and each free basis inclusion, and evaluate on the germ of 1 to get equality of all finitely many generator image germs. Apply the proved private exists_restrict_eq_of_free_germs_eq helper from FiniteFreeStalkMapEquality, available by a proof-only import all; its finite intersection argument allows arbitrary target sheaves.

Cancel the restricted splitting by precomposing with the inclusion. Send the resulting open into X by W.ι and descend equality along its image-open isomorphism using restrict_map_injective_of_isIso. Transport across restrictFunctorComp and overMapCompOverEquiv using map_eq_of_iso, both proved private helpers in FiniteFreeStalkMapEquality. Empty rank requires no special case: the free coproduct helper handles an empty finite index set.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01CP, finite-type injectivity proof; categorical implementation adapted from exists_open_stalk_retract_map_eq, with the proved finite-germ and restriction comparison helpers of FiniteFreeStalkMapEquality.

theorem exists_open_stalk_retract_hom_eq
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    (hM : ∃ m : ℕ,
      ∃ (ι : M ⟶ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
        (π : SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ M),
        ι ≫ π = 𝟙 M)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))
    (x : X) (hxW : x ∈ W)
    (a b : (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE hWU)).obj M ⟶ N)
    (heq : (openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).map a =
      (openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).map b) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hVW : V ≤ W), x ∈ V ∧
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hVW)).map a =
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE hVW)).map b
